entries.name: The Placeholder Crypt
entries.summary: A small family crypt under a hill, robbed long ago and not empty since.

rooms.name: The Broken Stair
rooms.text: Worn steps lead down into the dark; several have fallen away.

rooms.name: The Ossuary
rooms.text: Shelves of skulls line a low vault. Something has been moving them.

rooms.name: The Founder's Tomb
rooms.text: A carved sarcophagus with its lid pushed half aside.

hoard.text: Grave goods the robbers missed, under a loose flagstone.
